label: Additional commitment, not attributed to Aristotle: every being is accessible under the relation…
paraphrase: Additional commitment, not attributed to Aristotle: every being is accessible under the relation “moves this thing, is another than it, and is itself moved by another”. This supplies well-founded induction and excludes finite cycles. STMT-NO-INFINITE-DISTINCT-MOVERS-MOVED-BY-ANOTHER records the weaker source-level prohibition of infinitely many distinct movers; that prohibition is not taken to establish accessibility.
